Locant 1 is retained because skeletal replacement fixes the parent numbering.
The hydroxy suffix receives its locant under the fixed numbering.
The carboxylic-acid suffix follows the fixed heterochain numbering.
The double bond is located under the fixed chain numbering.
The nonstandard sulfur bonding number is cited after its locant.
The sulfur atom with higher bonding number receives the lower locant.
A retained heterocyclic parent hydride is modified by functional replacement.
Peroxo functional replacement is expressed in a preferred suffix.

Sulfur replacement at the oxo oxygen is distinguished from S-acid replacement.

Peroxo replacement is illustrated for a preselected suffix.
Hydrazono replacement is illustrated for a preselected suffix.
Thio replacement generates the preferred acid suffix.
The preferred suffix is thioamide and is not contracted to thiamide.

Seleno replacement of hydroxy oxygen is expressed by the selenol suffix.

The cyclic component is cited before the principal-group component in the conjunctive name.
